name: move
doc: Move one tile in the given direction.

name: mine
doc: Mine the tile the miner stands on. Returns a dict with ok, and reason or ore when relevant.

name: peek
doc: Return the ore on the current tile, None if empty, or 'unknown' if the ore is locked.

name: position
doc: Return the miner position as (x, y).

name: sell
doc: Sell the whole inventory at the base and return the money gained.

name: inventory
doc: Return the inventory as a dict of ore id to count.

name: scan
doc: Scan for ore within radius tiles. Returns a list of (dx, dy, ore_id) for non-empty tiles.

name: stats
doc: Return per-ore mining statistics as {ore: {'attempts': n, 'successes': m}}.

name: buy_upgrade
doc: Buy the next level of the given upgrade and return the new level.
